claims.claim: OFFLIMITS sells apparel categories including tees, joggers, track pants and tracksuits, with separate men's and women's collection routes.
Wiktech is the brand's named technology for faster moisture evaporation, but availability must be checked on an individual product page.
Loose-fitting, lightweight, moisture-wicking clothes are advised for exercise in hot conditions, and high heat plus humidity can justify moving exercise indoors.
Heat and humidity can contribute to heat-related illness, and confusion, dizziness, weakness and nausea warrant stopping and responding to symptoms.

sources.extracted_facts: OFFLIMITS is an Indian performance footwear and apparel brand. The documented apparel range includes tracksuits, joggers, tees, polos and shorts. Wiktech is the brand's moisture-evaporation technology. Voice is motivational, inclusive and value-conscious.
The current site exposes men's summer, camo shorts, men's joggers and track pants, women's graphic T-shirts and related apparel collections.
ACSM advises loose-fitting, lightweight, moisture-wicking clothing for exercise in heat and says indoor exercise may be appropriate when temperature exceeds 80 F and humidity exceeds 75 percent.
CDC advises hydration and action to prevent illness when the body becomes too hot.
NIOSH lists signs of heat-related illness and notes that excessive sweating depletes salt and moisture; heat rash is associated with excessive sweating in hot, humid weather.
